title.en: Java’s Cultivation System: crops, compulsion and colonial revenue
title.zh: 爪哇强制种植制度：作物、强制与殖民财政

summary.en:
Introduced in 1830, the Dutch colonial Cultivation System obliged Javanese cultivators to produce goods for European markets and deliver them through governmental arrangements at fixed prices. Agricultural work was connected to colonial budgets and commercial transport, rather than being a voluntary exchange among equal parties.

The Nationaal Archief’s catalog records crop production, land, labor obligations and administrative finance. Such archives expose the categories through which officials managed resources, but their accounting viewpoint does not describe every cultivator’s experience. The selected nineteenth-century window follows the system’s principal period without claiming that coercive labor relations ended in 1870. Connecting this record to Batavia and Indonesian independence explains economic institutions between the founding of a colonial center and the much later end of colonial rule.
summary.zh:
1830年引入的荷兰殖民强制种植制度，要求爪哇耕作者为欧洲市场生产作物，并通过政府安排按固定价格交付。农业劳动同殖民预算和商业运输相连，并非平等主体之间的自愿交换。

荷兰国家档案馆目录记录作物生产、土地、劳动义务与行政财政，显示官员管理资源的分类，但账目视角无法描述每位耕作者的经历。所选十九世纪窗口关注制度的主要时期，不表示强制劳动关系于1870年结束。将本条连接巴达维亚和印度尼西亚独立，可以解释殖民中心建立与更晚殖民统治终结之间的经济制度。

title.en: Pridi Banomyong: law, education and contested constitutional change
title.zh: 比里·帕侬荣：法律、教育与有争议的宪制变革

summary.en:
Pridi Banomyong helped lead the 1932 change from absolute monarchy and connected legal reform with education and public institutions. His role in founding Thammasat University in 1934 placed learning within the project of a new political order. Later participation in the Free Thai movement added wartime resistance to this institutional career.

His life also included political defeat and exile, so it should not be read as a continuous triumph of constitutional ideals. Biographical accounts produced by memorial institutions emphasize particular achievements; his own writings are primary evidence for arguments he made, not independent confirmation of every claim about his conduct. Reading those materials together connects the existing 1932 milestone to the people and institutions that worked through its unsettled consequences.
summary.zh:
比里·帕侬荣参与领导1932年从绝对君主制向新秩序的转变，并将法律改革同教育及公共机构相连。1934年创办法政大学的角色，使学习进入新政治秩序的建设；后来参与自由泰运动，又为制度生涯增添战时抵抗。

其人生也包含政治挫败和流亡，不能读成宪政理想连续胜利的故事。纪念机构传记强调特定成就；本人的著作是其论证的第一手证据，却不能独立确认关于行为的每项断言。并读这些材料，可将已有1932年节点连接到处理其不稳定后果的人物与机构。

title.en: Myanmar textiles: techniques, labor and collected evidence
title.zh: 缅甸纺织品：技术、劳动与收藏证据

summary.en:
Textiles from Myanmar connect cultivation, dyeing, weaving and exchange with the social meanings of clothing. Museum scientific work can identify materials and techniques that written political histories often leave unrecorded. Objects associated with Karen communities also challenge an account in which the whole region possesses one undifferentiated culture.

A collected textile has more than one history: production and use, transfer to a collection, and later scientific interpretation. The survival of an object does not establish the identity of every maker or every person who wore a similar pattern. Colonial-era collecting shaped what museums can now study and how it was classified. Following those layers brings ordinary work into the atlas while treating scientific findings as evidence about particular materials, not permission to assign a fixed ethnic identity to everyone in a mapped area.
summary.zh:
缅甸纺织品把种植、染色、织造与交换，同衣着的社会意义连接。博物馆科学研究能够识别政治文字史常忽略的材料和技法。同克伦群体相关的器物，也反驳了整个区域拥有一种无差别文化的叙述。

一件入藏纺织品包含多重历史：制作与使用、转入收藏，以及后来的科学解释。器物留存不能确定每位制作者身份，也不能代表所有穿相近纹样的人。殖民时期收藏影响今日可研究内容及其分类。追踪这些层次，可以使普通劳动进入地图，同时把科学结果限定于具体材料，不据此为某片地区每个人赋予固定族群身份。

title.en: Restored Lê: royal legitimacy beside rival governing houses
title.zh: 黎中兴：竞争执政家族旁的王室正统

summary.en:
The restoration of a Lê court did not simply recreate the administrative conditions of the Early Lê dynasty. Rivals claimed legitimacy while powerful families exercised practical authority. A royal title and the capacity to command resources could belong to different institutions, so the continued dynasty name should not be read as uniformly centralized government.

The Mạc and Restored Lê phases overlapped, and later Trịnh–Nguyễn competition divided governing authority between northern and southern political worlds. Commercial centers and religious production continued through these conflicts. Keeping a separate restored phase fills the chronological gap between the Early Lê and Nguyễn entries without disguising factional government. The terminal date follows the National Museum’s 1788 convention; the final court’s collapse and subsequent claims can be dated differently in detailed accounts.
summary.zh:
黎氏宫廷复立并非简单恢复黎初的行政状况。竞争者声称正统，强势家族则掌握实际权力。王号与调集资源的能力可能分属于不同机构，因此王朝名称延续不表示始终实行同样的中央集权。

莫氏与黎中兴阶段重叠，后来的郑、阮竞争又把实际治理分为南北不同政治世界。商业中心和宗教生产在冲突中继续存在。单列中兴阶段，可填补黎初与阮朝之间的编年空缺，同时不掩盖家族执政。终点采用国家历史博物馆1788年的分期；末代宫廷崩溃及后续主张，在更细研究中可能另有纪年。

title.en: Trịnh and Nguyễn: regional government under shared dynastic claims
title.zh: 郑氏与阮氏：共同王朝主张下的区域治理

location.label: Northern andcentral Vietnam; representative comparison point

summary.en:
Northern Trịnh and southern Nguyễn governing houses developed distinct centers while appealing to Lê legitimacy. Their rivalry produced more than battles between families: it altered administration, resource demands and the relationships through which communities encountered political power. Regional autonomy could coexist with the language of one dynasty.

Early modern upheaval also involved economic change, displacement and forced military or labor service. These processes connected court competition to the lives of rural populations rather than leaving social history outside the political account. Port commerce and regional settlement patterns should therefore be studied alongside dynastic titles. The focus ends around the beginning of the Tây Sơn upheaval, not a claim that all Trịnh or Nguyễn institutions disappeared in 1771. The later Nguyễn imperial dynasty belongs to a subsequent political arrangement.
summary.zh:
北方郑氏与南方阮氏建立不同执政中心，同时援引黎朝正统。竞争不只是家族之间的战斗，也改变行政、资源要求，以及社区接触政治权力的关系。区域自主可以同一个王朝的语言并存。

近世动荡还涉及经济变化、流离及强制兵役或劳役。这些过程把宫廷竞争同农村人口生活相连，而不是把社会史留在政治叙述之外。因此，港口商业和区域聚落应同王朝名号一起研究。窗口结束于西山动荡开始前后，不表示所有郑、阮机构在1771年消失。后来的阮朝帝制属于下一阶段政治安排。

title.en: Brunei at Kota Batu: a river court in maritime networks
title.zh: 哥打峇都时期的文莱：海上网络中的河流宫廷

location.label: Kota Batu, Brunei River; representative royal andcommercial center

summary.en:
Kota Batu connected a Bruneian court with a river port and wider South China Sea commerce. Archaeological ceramics and the cargo of a nearby shipwreck link local demand with production in China and Southeast Asia. The 1408 visit of a Bruneian royal delegation to Nanjing adds documentary evidence of court-level relations, without demonstrating direct control over every place involved in trade.

The relationship between commercial and political authority also involved hinterland suppliers and people who handled goods along the river. A ship’s cargo cannot be treated as a complete survey of all commerce or proof of an exact route; the published wreck date is estimated from objects. This premodern court deserves its own entry rather than being inferred from Brunei’s 1984 independence or today’s borders. Its 1400–1600 focus is not the full sultanate lifespan.
summary.zh:
哥打峇都把文莱宫廷、河港及更广泛的南海商业连接起来。考古陶瓷和附近沉船货物，将本地需求同中国及东南亚生产相联。1408年文莱王室使团到访南京的记载，另为宫廷关系提供文献证据，却不能证明宫廷直接控制每处贸易地点。

商业与政治权威的关系，也涉及腹地供货者及沿河转运货物的人。单艘船货不能当作全部商业的调查，亦不能证明精确航线；发表的沉船年代依据器物估算。这样的前近代宫廷应有独立条目，不能从1984年独立或今天国界倒推。1400—1600年只是研究重点，不是苏丹国完整寿命。
